lost_reason: No decision — internal hiring freeze halted all software purchases

calls.notes: Sanjay initiated contact. Legacy ERP causing integration nightmares with new cloud warehouse system. Pain is real and urgent — monthly reconciliation takes 6 days manually. He estimated $200K/year in operational loss. Said CTO Kavitha is supportive. Budget TBD.

Technical deep-dive with Sanjay + 2 engineers. Integration architecture questions answered well. Our solution fit was strong. CTO still not joining — Sanjay said she is in a board review cycle. Asked us to prepare a technical proposal.
red_flags: CTO avoiding calls — 2nd time not present
board review = potential org change signal

calls.notes: Submitted 28-page technical proposal. Sanjay loved it. CTO finally joined — 15 minutes, asked 2 questions, left early. She seemed distracted. Sanjay messaged later that internal discussions are ongoing. No clear next step defined.

Follow-up call. Sanjay revealed that there is a company-wide hiring and spending freeze following a regulatory audit. All non-critical purchases paused. He is personally supportive but his hands are tied. No timeline for resume.
Last check-in. Freeze still in place. Sanjay apologized, said to reconnect in Q1 2025. Marked as lost for this year. Relationship intact.

lessons_learned: CTO not on first 2 calls = early warning of disengagement at top
Board review cycle mentioned early = should have flagged org instability risk
28-page technical proposal to an absent decision-maker = effort wasted
No budget confirmed after 3 calls = stall signal ignored
Should have asked for a multi-stakeholder meeting by call 2
Spending freezes are unwinnable — exit early, preserve relationship for next cycle
